en: Two names that expand the vocabulary
The vocabulary grows without becoming a list of ten. One name reaches those who are not consumers, and the other measures how much each case demands.
<1><2>The civil genus of which the IOC is the consumer-law species, for those who depend on a platform without being consumers.</2><3>Governed Enjoyment Intangible Object (GEIO)</3></1>
<1><2>The principle that measures the supplier's duties by the choices it made itself.</2><3>Autometry</3></1>
